hero_heading: Five Years of Craft, One Signature Finish
story: For over five years, Coral has specialized in the design and manufacturing of Cubic Zirconia Rose Gold jewellery from Surat. Every piece is shaped by hands-on craftsmanship and quality checks that reflect our commitment to consistency — from a single custom piece to bulk wholesale orders. We combine timeless rose gold tones with sparkling CZ stones to create jewellery that feels premium without the premium price tag.
mission_draft: To make signature rose gold jewellery accessible — pairing CZ craftsmanship with honest pricing, so every piece feels premium without the premium price tag.
vision_draft: To be the rose gold CZ jewellery partner wholesalers trust first, known for consistent quality, dependable turnaround, and designs that keep pace with what customers want next.
facility_highlights: Based in Surat, India — a hub for jewellery manufacturing.
5+ years of dedicated CZ Rose Gold production experience.
Hands-on quality checks at every stage before dispatch.
Capacity for both single custom pieces and bulk wholesale orders.
